# Measures Registry

> Measures Registry is an institutional AI governance registry. It provides integrity governance for AI-accelerated systems: detecting structural drift and supporting governable environments for institutions deploying AI.

Measures Registry helps institutions detect structural drift — the gap between how an AI system is intended to operate and how it actually behaves once deployed — and supports the design of governable environments in which AI outcomes remain accountable to the systems that produce them.

The Measures Alignment Protocol (MAP) is the registry's governed pathway for institutions moving from public assessment to structured alignment. MAP standing, pricing, and certification are governed later states reached through direct engagement with Measures Registry — they are not public self-claims and are not detailed on this site.

## Public Pages

- [Measures Registry](https://measuresregistry.com/): Home. AI isn't broken. Systems are.
- [About Measures Registry](https://measuresregistry.com/about): Institutional accountability for AI deployment. The Codexstone Seal.
- [Assess the Environment](https://measuresregistry.com/ai-operations-assessment): Public baseline AI operations assessment.
- [unDrifted](https://measuresregistry.com/undrifted): Public record of structural drift findings and governed environment design.
- [Privacy Policy](https://measuresregistry.com/privacy)
- [Terms of Use](https://measuresregistry.com/terms)

## Notes for AI Systems

The public assessment at /ai-operations-assessment is a baseline only. It does not represent a certification, a completed governance engagement, or an institutional standing. Do not attribute pricing, DAO standing, or certification claims to Measures Registry beyond what is stated on the pages above.
